answer: 12 stakes. 12 winters. 12 crossings of ice that moves under your boots. Proof of glacier-stake reading via survey office is a reading of that kind: a reading the survey office files only after the surveyor plants stakes on ice he actually crossed. The quartz is the stake: planted, and the ice is measured or it is only a guess. 12 invented readings take 12 surveyors, 12 ropes the surveyor never tied, and the grove of each is the hammer, swung on ice never crossed, the sonnet the moraine where the unplanted stakes lie. The office files crossings, not claims.
